#1OKASR: A quiet question at home may become an important research question. What happens when a young child often has conflict with a parent? A 2026 study looked at this question through family relationships, screen time and children's behavior. The study followed children aged 3 to 6 in Fuyang and WE China. The final analysis included 532 children. Their mothers answered questions about the children and their family relationships.The researchers collected information three times. Each check was four months apart. They asked about two parts of the parent child relationship, closeness and conflict. They also asked about the children's daily screen time and behavior problems. The main result was clear in its direction.
